items.claim: Polygon/star on a flipped pose took a negative radius and overflowed its box
`hasStroke` said "no stroke" for a painted stroke with no width, which every painter draws 1 wide
`kit:path` cull bounds ignored a pose override's path
items.note: The painter's `bounds` now measures `ctx.derivedPath`, or returns null for a path in parts. The real gap was the scene view's cull, which never passed that path on. It now does, through a new `withOverridePathBounds` in `canvas/derivedPath.ts`, and `PaintBoundsFn` and `defaultPaintBounds` both accept `derivedPath`. Reproduced with a node whose stored pose is off screen and whose override path is on screen.

items.claim: `kit:path-pose` drawnBounds dropped the fill when the stroke covers only part of the outline (trim, dash or inner stroke)
items.note: `drawnBoundsOf` already hid this by unioning the pose box, but the exported `findShapeDrawnBounds` returned the narrow box.

items.claim: `kit:derived` drawnBounds ignored the fill, so a fill-only, inner-stroked or trimmed path got a box that left the fill out
items.note: Each painted part now adds its outline's own box. `drawnBoundsOf`'s `derivedBoundsOf` already unioned the path box, so only direct `findShapeDrawnBounds` callers saw this, including `kit:path` with a `derivedPath`.
